name: Sunder Step
description: Cut a line through the space ahead and step along the cut to a point beyond a foe.

name: Sunder Shield
description: Hold a sundered gap before the body so a blow falls into the break and is spent.

name: Sunder Reach
description: Split the space about a foe's limbs so each tears away from the body and cannot rise.

name: Sunder Sense
description: Feel every break and seam in the space of a field and learn which are fresh.

name: Sunder Lance
description: Drive a lance of sundered space through every guard and body along one straight line.

name: Rend Guard
description: Raise a broad wall of sundered space that tears apart lesser blows before they land.

name: Sunder Chain
description: Open sundering cuts in quick order along three lines until the foe is hemmed in on every side.

name: Sunder Pull
description: Pull the edges of a sundered gap together over a group until none of them can rise.

name: Sunder Wave
description: Send a wave of sundering through the ground and air that splits all it crosses.

name: Sunder Skip
description: Pass through a sundered gap and out of its twin on the far side of the field.

name: Sunder Core
description: Split the space inside a foe's body along its centre so no ward or plate turns the cut.

name: Sundered Sky
description: Split the air above a field along a great line whose reach and weight follow the qi poured into it.

name: Sundering Cataclysm
description: Tear one vast rift through sky and ground so all caught in the field is lost up to the ceiling of a Demigod.

name: Collapse Stride
description: Collapse the distance ahead into nothing and arrive at the far point in one step.

name: Collapse Guard
description: Draw the space before the body inward so a blow is crushed on the way to it.

name: Collapse Snare
description: Collapse the space about a foe's frame until it closes on the limbs like a fist.

name: Collapse Sense
description: Draw the near field inward and read each body as a point of weight within it.

name: Collapse Lance
description: Draw a lance of collapsing space through a foe and leave a hollow where it passed.

name: Collapse Veil
description: Draw a veil of collapsing space about the user that crushes weak strikes to nothing.

name: Collapse Chain
description: Collapse three points of space in quick order round a foe so each draws them nearer the last.

name: Collapse Press
description: Hold a slow collapse over a group until each of them is pressed to the ground.

name: Collapse Wave
description: Send a ring of collapsing space outward that crushes all within its sweep.

name: Collapse Leap
description: Collapse the field between two points and cross it in a single unseen instant.

name: Collapse Heart
description: Collapse the space about a foe's heart so the body folds inward past the reach of any ward.

name: Collapsed World
description: Draw a field of space into a single point whose pull and weight follow the core's reserve.

name: Spatial Implosion
description: Draw a vast reach of space into itself so all within is crushed up to the ceiling of a Core-tier master.
